name: trendsmesh-playbooks
description: TrendsMesh playbooks: refresh a fading Meta ad with rising trends; trend research for a category; creative briefs for new ads; organic AI videos for your channels

replicate_api_token.title: Replicate API token
replicate_api_token.description: Makes the AI images and video; each run is paid from your Replicate account. Make a token at https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens (Create token, then copy it). Credit and payment method: https://replicate.com/account/billing. Optional; stored in your system credential store.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Makes the voices and the music, from your ElevenLabs credits. Make a key at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys (Developers, API Keys, Create key). If you restrict it, allow Text to Speech, Voices (read and write), Audio Isolation, Music Generation, History (read) and User (read). Optional; stored in your system credential store.
